Akshay Anvekar

Data Scientist | NLP & Generative AI Engineer | LLM

Bengaluru, India,	9591466598	akshay1ga13ec007@gmail.com

Summary

Results-driven Data Scientist and AI Engineer with over 5 years of experience in Machine Learning, NLP, and Generative AI, specializing in building intelligent systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). Skilled in transformer-based architectures such as GPT, Mistral, LLaMA, Gemma, and BERT, with hands-on expertise in ne-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and FastAPI-based deployments on GCP. Delivered impactful projects in customer analytics, churn prediction, and AI automation that enhanced decision-making and e ciency. Passionate about developing scalable, real-world AI solutions that combine research innovation with business value. Immediate joiner.

Experience

Professional development07/2025

 Pursued advanced hands-on specialization in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI after June 2025, focusing on transformer architectures, RAG frameworks, ne-tuning, and multi-agent orchestration.

 Engineered multi-prompt, multi-model LLM systems integrating OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA 3.1/2 for automation, reasoning, and cross-language code translation.

 Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, ChromaDB, and Hugging Face embeddings with conversational memory, semantic retrieval, and embedding visualization (t-SNE, Plotly).

  Developed agentic reasoning frameworks combining LLMs with structured tools (Wikipedia, Arxiv, DuckDuckGo) to enable zero-shot reasoning, dynamic search, and contextual decision-making.

 Executed parameter-e cient ne-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA 4-bit) of LLaMA and Gemma models using Hugging Face TRL SFTTrainer for domain adaptation and GPU-optimized inference.

 Built LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems measuring accuracy, consistency, latency, and reasoning quality across GPT, Claude, and Hugging Face models, with visual analytics via Matplotlib & NumPy.

 Integrated Neo4j AuraDB with LangChain GraphCypherQAChain to enable natural-language querying over graph data, bridging symbolic reasoning with transformer-based inference.

  Architected production-ready multi-agent systems, including “The Price is Right”—a seven-agent platform using GPT- 4, Claude, and a custom RAG Chroma (400K products) database for autonomous deal discovery and price prediction.

 Optimized and deployed LLM applications using Gradio, Streamlit, and Modal Cloud Platform, incorporating logging, type hints, modular design, and GPU acceleration for scalable, low-latency inference.

Data Scientist - NLP & Machine Learning08/2022 - 06/2025

Tata Insights and Quants - A Division of Tata Ind, Bengaluru, Karnataka

 Experienced in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning, and Generative AI, specializing in LLM-based text processing, classi cation, and semantic understanding using models such as Mistral-7B, Mistral-NeMo (128K), BERT, BART, and Sentence-BERT.

 Designed and deployed FastAPI-based multi-GPU inference services for scalable, low-latency LLM pipelines performing grammar correction, tone rewriting, and summarization using Mistral models.

 Developed an LLM-powered customer–support interaction classi er using Mistral-NeMo, categorizing ~1 lakh records into 20 prede ned customer experience themes with contextual reasoning and con dence scoring.



 Built semantic similarity–based recommendation systems using Sentence-BERT embeddings and cosine similarity, automating jury–idea matching through explainable NLP logic.

 Designed and deployed churn prediction and high-risk account classi cation models, leveraging advanced data cleaning, feature engineering, and machine learning techniques to predict customer churn probability and overdue risk based on payment behavior and due-date patterns.

 Applied Few-Shot Learning (FSL) and Prompt Engineering to enhance transformer adaptability and improve accuracy on real-world multi-class text classi cation tasks.

 Implemented and ne-tuned binary and multi-class classi cation models achieving >95% accuracy in tone detection, empathy analysis, and text similarity prediction.

 Deployed AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and on-prem multi-GPU servers, optimizing GPU utilization, concurrency handling, and runtime e ciency.

 Experienced in end-to-end ML pipeline design, covering data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and reporting using Python, PyTorch, Transformers, Pandas, and OpenPyXL.

 Delivered production-grade AI applications that enhanced report quality, automated customer experience analytics, and improved retention and risk prediction across enterprise datasets.

Data Scientist 109/2020 - 08/2022 FEDO HEALTH, Bengaluru, Karnataka

 Developed and deployed machine learning models for accurate medical expense prediction using Python, Power BI, and advanced statistical analysis, driving actionable insights for healthcare decision-making.

 Engineered facial analysis models leveraging Transfer Learning, VGGFace (ImageNet), and OpenCV to predict age, gender, BMI, and smoker status with high precision.

  Processed and analyzed large-scale health record datasets (2M+ records) to build the Fedo Score, an AI-driven disease risk assessment metric integrating multi-modal data.

 Designed a synthetic data generation framework to enhance insurance underwriting models and improve classi cation accuracy across high-dimensional medical datasets.

 Integrated face, audio, and NLP models into onboarding and claims processes, enabling automated claim propensity prediction and improving operational e ciency.

 Built interactive dashboards and time-series forecasting models in Python and Power BI for comorbidity prediction and executive-level reporting.

Data Analyst10/2019 - 04/2020

Business Toys Private Limited, Bengaluru, Karnataka

  Applied advanced data analysis techniques to interpret complex datasets, addressing business and operational challenges.

 Collaborated with the consulting team to perform end-to-end data preparation — including extraction, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis — using MySQL, Python, and Advanced Excel.

 Contributed to the design of interactive dashboards and performance reports, enabling data-driven decision-making.  Supported the development and training of machine learning and deep learning models for predictive analytics.

 Assisted in educational content creation for Data Science programs aimed at upskilling students and professionals in applied analytics and ML fundamentals.

Education

Bachelor of Engineering - BE, 2013 - 2017

Visvesvaraya Technological University, Bengaluru, Karnataka

PG Diploma, 2018 - 2019 ILS, Bengaluru



Skills

Large Language Models (LLMs)		Natural Language Processing (NLP)

Machine Learning & Deep Learning		Generative AI

Python

Websites and Social Links

Linkedin:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshay-anvekar-617095153/

Delivered impactful projects in customer analytics, churn prediction, and AI automation that enhanced decision-making and e ciency. Passionate about developing scalable, real-world AI solutions that combine research innovation with business value. Immediate joiner.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Experience
Professional development07/2025
 Pursued advanced hands-on specialization in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI after June 2025, focusing on transformer architectures, RAG frameworks, ne-tuning, and multi-agent orchestration.
 Engineered multi-prompt, multi-model LLM systems integrating OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA 3.1/2 for automation, reasoning, and cross-language code translation.
 Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, ChromaDB, and Hugging Face embeddings with conversational memory, semantic retrieval, and embedding visualization (t-SNE, Plotly).
  Developed agentic reasoning frameworks combining LLMs with structured tools (Wikipedia, Arxiv, DuckDuckGo) to enable zero-shot reasoning, dynamic search, and contextual decision-making.
 Executed parameter-e cient ne-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA 4-bit) of LLaMA and Gemma models using Hugging Face TRL SFTTrainer for domain adaptation and GPU-optimized inference.
 Built LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems measuring accuracy, consistency, latency, and reasoning quality across GPT, Claude, and Hugging Face models, with visual analytics via Matplotlib & NumPy.
 Integrated Neo4j AuraDB with LangChain GraphCypherQAChain to enable natural-language querying over graph data, bridging symbolic reasoning with transformer-based inference.
  Architected production-ready multi-agent systems, including “The Price is Right”—a seven-agent platform using GPT- 4, Claude, and a custom RAG Chroma (400K products) database for autonomous deal discovery and price prediction.
 Optimized and deployed LLM applications using Gradio, Streamlit, and Modal Cloud Platform, incorporating logging, type hints, modular design, and GPU acceleration for scalable, low-latency inference.
Data Scientist - NLP & Machine Learning08/2022 - 06/2025
Tata Insights and Quants - A Division of Tata Ind, Bengaluru, Karnataka
 Experienced in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning, and Generative AI, specializing in LLM-based text processing, classi cation, and semantic understanding using models such as Mistral-7B, Mistral-NeMo (128K), BERT, BART, and Sentence-BERT.
 Designed and deployed FastAPI-based multi-GPU inference services for scalable, low-latency LLM pipelines performing grammar correction, tone rewriting, and summarization using Mistral models.
 Developed an LLM-powered customer–support interaction classi er using Mistral-NeMo, categorizing ~1 lakh records into 20 prede ned customer experience themes with contextual reasoning and con dence scoring.
 Built semantic similarity–based recommendation systems using Sentence-BERT embeddings and cosine similarity, automating jury–idea matching through explainable NLP logic.
 Designed and deployed churn prediction and high-risk account classi cation models, leveraging advanced data cleaning, feature engineering, and machine learning techniques to predict customer churn probability and overdue risk based on payment behavior and due-date patterns.
 Applied Few-Shot Learning (FSL) and Prompt Engineering to enhance transformer adaptability and improve accuracy on real-world multi-class text classi cation tasks.
 Implemented and ne-tuned binary and multi-class classi cation models achieving >95% accuracy in tone detection, empathy analysis, and text similarity prediction.
 Deployed AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and on-prem multi-GPU servers, optimizing GPU utilization, concurrency handling, and runtime e ciency.
 Experienced in end-to-end ML pipeline design, covering data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and reporting using Python, PyTorch, Transformers, Pandas, and OpenPyXL.
 Delivered production-grade AI applications that enhanced report quality, automated customer experience analytics, and improved retention and risk prediction across enterprise datasets.
Data Scientist 109/2020 - 08/2022 FEDO HEALTH, Bengaluru, Karnataka
 Developed and deployed machine learning models for accurate medical expense prediction using Python, Power BI, and advanced statistical analysis, driving actionable insights for healthcare decision-making.
 Engineered facial analysis models leveraging Transfer Learning, VGGFace (ImageNet), and OpenCV to predict age, gender, BMI, and smoker status with high precision.
  Processed and analyzed large-scale health record datasets (2M+ records) to build the Fedo Score, an AI-driven disease risk assessment metric integrating multi-modal data.
 Designed a synthetic data generation framework to enhance insurance underwriting models and improve classi cation accuracy across high-dimensional medical datasets.
 Integrated face, audio, and NLP models into onboarding and claims processes, enabling automated claim propensity prediction and improving operational e ciency.
 Built interactive dashboards and time-series forecasting models in Python and Power BI for comorbidity prediction and executive-level reporting.
Data Analyst10/2019 - 04/2020
Business Toys Private Limited, Bengaluru, Karnataka
  Applied advanced data analysis techniques to interpret complex datasets, addressing business and operational challenges.
 Collaborated with the consulting team to perform end-to-end data preparation — including extraction, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis — using MySQL, Python, and Advanced Excel.
 Contributed to the design of interactive dashboards and performance reports, enabling data-driven decision-making.  Supported the development and training of machine learning and deep learning models for predictive analytics.
 Assisted in educational content creation for Data Science programs aimed at upskilling students and professionals in applied analytics and ML fundamentals.
